Bow.name: Bow
Bow.description: A virtual bow, reloaded as part of an Attack Action.

Dagger.name: Dagger
Dagger.description: A virtual knife fit for a hunter.

Duel Caster.name: Duel Caster
Duel Caster.description:
A card launcher constructed from cheap plastic used to launch @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.elflines_ammo.Item.gbp8WiY21LEcNnif]{ELO Trading Cards}. ROF 3 if it is the only weapon fired on your turn.

Can also be loaded with normal playing cards but makes the weapon Poor Quality.

Greataxe.name: Greataxe
Greataxe.description: A virtual axe with a curved blade on each side. Favoured by raid parties for close engagements. Requires 2 hands to wield even by a wielder with BODY 8 or higher.

Longsword.name: Longsword
Longsword.description:
A bladed, hilted weapon. Specifically designed for virtual combat.

2 ROF if wielding a second longsword — requires manual update

Scarlet Blackbow.name: Scarlet Blackbow
Scarlet Blackbow.description: A plastic toy bow that must be reloaded after every attack. If you roll 1 on Attack (Crit fail) the bow's battery pack explodes. Comes bundeled with a Quiver and @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_ammo.Item.tXkeWEPGKEJEgCPW]{6 Rubber Arrows}.

Shortsword.name: Shortsword
Shortsword.description: A short bladed, hilted weapon. Specifically designed for virtual combat.

Sword of Arvish.name: Sword of Arvish
Sword of Arvish.description: A metal replica of the hero's blade! If you roll 1 on Attack (Crit Fail) the wielder suffers the @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_critical-injuries-body.Item.IKKcCgHU1lBJ4wVd]{Crushed Fingers} critical injury.
